name: etubu
description: ETUBU — EV/Tesla driving cluster, dashboard and drive-sound companion app.

scripts.build:ios: xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme Etubu -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build
scripts.test:maestro: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/bin:$HOME/.maestro/bin:$PATH" JAVA_HOME="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17" && DEV=$(xcrun simctl list devices | sed -n 's/.*iPhone 17 Pro (\([A-F0-9-]*\)).*(Booted).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$DEV" ] || DEV=$(xcrun simctl list devices | sed -n 's/.*iPhone 17 Pro (\([A-F0-9-]*\)).*/\1/p' | head -1); xcrun simctl location "$DEV" set 41.0082,28.9784 2>/dev/null || xcrun simctl location booted set 41.0082,28.9784; maestro test --device "$DEV" .maestro/smoke-onboarding.yaml .maestro/onboarding-flow.yaml .maestro/legal-reject-blocked.yaml .maestro/premium-route-lock.yaml .maestro/route-plan-check.yaml .maestro/theme-landscape-check.yaml .maestro/theme-apply-check.yaml .maestro/remote-lang-check.yaml .maestro/remote-sheet-smoke.yaml .maestro/language-switch-en.yaml .maestro/demo-stop-sound-check.yaml .maestro/demo-drive-check.yaml .maestro/ev-plan-demo-check.yaml .maestro/power-save-chrome-check.yaml .maestro/remote-pin-check.yaml .maestro/exit-button-scroll-smoke.yaml
scripts.test:maestro:sound: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/bin:$HOME/.maestro/bin:$PATH" JAVA_HOME="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17" && DEV=$(xcrun simctl list devices | sed -n 's/.*iPhone 17 Pro (\([A-F0-9-]*\)).*(Booted).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$DEV" ] || DEV=$(xcrun simctl list devices | sed -n 's/.*iPhone 17 Pro (\([A-F0-9-]*\)).*/\1/p' | head -1); maestro test --device "$DEV" .maestro/demo-stop-sound-check.yaml
